_how_to: Kept empty on purpose: every official in the directory comes from an automated source in data/sources.json, so it can be re-checked on every run. To cover a new office, add a source (see README, 'Adding a source'); a city's council page usually works with the city_roster scraper. Only add an entry here as a last resort, with a source_url, and say why no source can be collected.
